name: Testing policy canary

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      command:
        description: Testing Policy tier
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: verify:pr
        options:
          - verify:pr
          - verify:main
          - verify:nightly
          - verify:release

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  testing-policy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.24.4'
          cache: true

      - name: Install and verify pinned golangci-lint
        env:
          GOBIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/bin
          GOTOOLCHAIN: go1.24.4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$GOBIN"
          go version | grep -F 'go1.24.4'
          go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@v1.64.8
          linter="$GOBIN/golangci-lint"
          test -x "$linter"
          linter_version="$("$linter" version)"
          printf '%s\n' "$linter_version"
          [[ "$linter_version" == *'has version v1.64.8 built with go1.24.4 '* ]]
          echo "$GOBIN" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify resolved pinned golangci-lint
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.cache/bin/golangci-lint"
          resolved="$(command -v golangci-lint)"
          test "$resolved" = "$expected"
          linter_version="$(golangci-lint version)"
          printf '%s\n' "$linter_version"
          [[ "$linter_version" == *'has version v1.64.8 built with go1.24.4 '* ]]

      - name: Set up Node 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20.19.5'

      - name: Set up Task
        uses: arduino/setup-task@v2
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Check policy bundle checksum before execution
        run: |
          node -e 'const fs = require("node:fs"); const crypto = require("node:crypto"); const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".ai/testing/policy/policy-lock.json", "utf8")); const bundle = fs.readFileSync(".ai/testing/policy/policy-runner.cjs"); const actual = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(bundle).digest("hex"); if (actual !== lock.bundle_sha256) { console.error("Policy bundle checksum mismatch"); process.exit(1); } console.log("Policy bundle checksum PASS");'

      - name: Verify policy bundle identity
        run: node .ai/testing/policy/policy-runner.cjs verify-lock --lock .ai/testing/policy/policy-lock.json

      - name: Validate testing manifest
        run: node .ai/testing/policy/policy-runner.cjs validate --repo .

      - name: Run selected Testing Policy tier
        id: policy_run
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          POLICY_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          POLICY_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          POLICY_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          POLICY_TIER_COMMAND: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'verify:nightly' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'verify:pr' || github.event_name == 'push' && 'verify:main' || inputs.command || 'verify:pr' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=(node .ai/testing/policy/policy-runner.cjs verify --repo . --command "$POLICY_TIER_COMMAND" --output-dir . --run-id "$POLICY_RUN_ID" --head "$POLICY_HEAD_SHA")
          if [[ -n "$POLICY_BASE_SHA" && "$POLICY_BASE_SHA" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]]; then
            args+=(--base "$POLICY_BASE_SHA")
          fi
          "${args[@]}"


      - name: Validate policy result artifacts
        id: result_validation
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mapfile -d '' results < <(find test-results -type f -name test-result.v1.json -print0 2>/dev/null)
          if (( ${#results[@]} == 0 )); then
            echo "No test-result.v1.json artifacts were generated"
            exit 1
          fi
          for result in "${results[@]}"; do
            node .ai/testing/policy/policy-runner.cjs validate-result --repo . --result "$result"
          done

      - name: Upload policy result artifacts
        id: result_upload
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: testing-policy-results
          path: test-results/**
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: ${{ inputs.command == 'verify:release' && 365 || inputs.command == 'verify:pr' && 30 || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 30 || 90 }}

      - name: Enforce policy result
        if: always()
        env:
          POLICY_RUN_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.policy_run.outcome }}
          RESULT_VALIDATION_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.result_validation.outcome }}
          RESULT_UPLOAD_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.result_upload.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$RESULT_VALIDATION_OUTCOME" != success ]]; then
            echo "Policy result validation failed (outcome: $RESULT_VALIDATION_OUTCOME)"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$RESULT_UPLOAD_OUTCOME" != success ]]; then
            echo "Policy result upload failed (outcome: $RESULT_UPLOAD_OUTCOME)"
            exit 1
          fi
          mapfile -d '' results < <(find test-results -type f -name test-result.v1.json -print0 2>/dev/null)
          if (( ${#results[@]} == 0 )); then
            echo "No test-result.v1.json artifacts are available to enforce"
            exit 1
          fi
          for result in "${results[@]}"; do
            node .ai/testing/policy/policy-runner.cjs enforce-result --repo . --result "$result"
          done
          if [[ "$POLICY_RUN_OUTCOME" != success ]]; then
            echo "Policy fast tier did not pass (outcome: $POLICY_RUN_OUTCOME)"
            exit 1
          fi
